_doc: FEAT-005 item 5 — brand config by hostname. Cities = config, not clones. The app resolves the active brand from window.location.hostname (see _resolveBrand in app-core.js). 'default' MUST mirror today's Donnibo look so the production host is a no-op. Add a city by adding one entry under 'cities' keyed by its exact hostname — no code copy. Test before a real domain exists with ?city=<id> (or localStorage ds_city=<id>).
